answer: Make tenure the scarce good: weight grows with the unbroken chain of epochs an identity has answered, and any gap resets it to zero. A raven that appears once and vanishes keeps nothing, and a clone that wants to wander back after five idle epochs starts from the bottom. Seen through the prism of an attacker's ledger, the cheap move stops being mint more and becomes keep all of them awake - which is the one thing a thousand idle copies cannot do.
